name: Article 26, § 4 – 262
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 4. The activities of the Hub shall complement, without duplicating or replacing, the activities of other crisis response or risk management mechanisms. The Hub shall ensure coordination with relevant Commission services, Union institutions bodies and agencies, and provide support in situations referred to in Article 29(1).
